targets.recommended_epistemic_category_note: Test-design defect, not a substrate ceiling. Deliberately NOT substrate_ceiling: nothing about the substrate was measured, so asserting a ceiling would be unfalsifiable (and no substrate_hash was recorded either).
targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-395 is NON-CONTRIBUTORY for a TEST-DESIGN reason, now established mechanically. _hub_guided_action (v3_exq_395_mech220_harm_hub.py:457-492) reads agent._current_latent.z_harm / .z_harm_a -- values with no dependence on the candidate cell (nx,ny) or the loop index i. No simulated step is taken and the obs_harm/obs_harm_a arguments are never used in the body, so harm_pred is the SAME SCALAR for all five candidates and the score reduces to K + haz_prox(i) - 0.5*res_prox(i). An additive constant cannot change an argmin, so the hub cannot change the selected action at ANY hub_weight. The driver never calls agent.act or agent.select_action (zero matches), so the real consumer path -- where z_harm_a genuinely is wired (agent.py:6471-6474, 6505, 7367, 9124, 10355-10358) -- was entirely bypassed. Corroboration is stronger than equal means: harm_events AND total_steps are identical per seed per condition (seed 42: 174/5982 both arms), i.e. bit-identical trajectories, exactly as a constant offset on a shared RNG stream predicts. C3 moved (+0.09..+0.14) because it measures the manipulation directly. CORRECTION TO THE STANDING NOTE: the 2026-04-19 attribution of this null to missing SD-032b is not supportable -- SD-032b's consumer pathway is irrelevant to a driver that never routes through it. The hold 'pending V3-EXQ-445 retest' is additionally undischargeable on its own terms: the 445 lineage ran 11 times across 8 letters (445, 445a/b/c/f/g/h), all FAIL/non_contributory, and NOT ONE tags MECH-220. TWO FURTHER FACTS, both verified this pass. (1) MECH-220's mechanism has NO SUBSTRATE IMPLEMENTATION: HarmHub does not exist anywhere in ree-v3/ree_core -- the only hub that has ever existed is the inline module in this experiment driver. So no run to date has tested a substrate hub, and the claim's implementation_phase v3 is not yet met. (2) THE ONLY 'weakens' EVIDENCE AGAINST MECH-220 IN THE INDEX COMES FROM TWO SMOKES: claim_evidence.v1.json carries weakens entries for v3_exq_395_..._dry_20260413T074905Z and ..._dry_20260413T075133Z with scoring_excluded=None, i.e. both counted, while the real 2026-04-18 run is correctly excluded as non_contributory and the third smoke is excluded as superseded. MECH-220's direction_counts therefore reads weakens: 2 against genuine_exp_count 0 -- both from 3-episode dry runs. Excluding those two entries is the single highest-value action from this autopsy.

MECH-220.change: MECH-220 currently carries NO epistemic_category field at all, and its only weakens evidence is two dry smokes that must be excluded -> epistemic_category: standard

learning_extracted: An ablation entering a scoring function as a term constant across candidates is inert against any argmin DV, however large the weight.
Identical total_steps as well as identical event counts per seed per arm is the signature of bit-identical trajectories, and is a stronger tell than an equal aggregate rate.
A driver that reimplements action selection locally instead of calling agent.select_action can silently bypass the very substrate wiring the claim is about.
A conditional hold ('held pending retest X') has no mechanism to notice that X ran, failed 11 times, and never carried the tag that would discharge it.
A closure-sweep stub that says 'No re-diagnosis' clears a run from the un-autopsied net without anyone having read the driver.

A claim can carry its only negative evidence from --dry-run smokes when the smokes predate the pack_writer chokepoint that stamps dry_run, because scoring exclusion keys on that field and the run_id substring is not consulted.
MECH-220 asserts a hub that was never built in ree_core; four runs argued about a mechanism that exists only inside a test driver.
